proof_body:
by
  classical
  intro α _ _ n hα
  have hpos : 0 < Fintype.card α := by omega
  obtain ⟨a₀⟩ : Nonempty α := Fintype.card_pos_iff.mp hpos
  have heq : ∀ a : α, (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin (n + 1) ≃ α => f 0 = a)).card = (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin (n + 1) ≃ α => f 0 = a₀)).card := by
    intro a
    refine Finset.card_equiv ((Equiv.refl (Fin (n + 1))).equivCongr (Equiv.swap a a₀)) ?_
    intro f
    simp only [Finset.mem_filter, Finset.mem_univ, true_and, Equiv.equivCongr_apply_apply, Equiv.refl_symm, Equiv.refl_apply]
    constructor
    · intro h; rw [h, Equiv.swap_apply_left]
    · intro h
      have := congrArg (Equiv.swap a a₀) h
      rwa [Equiv.swap_apply_self, Equiv.swap_apply_right] at this
  have hsum : ∑ a : α, (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin (n + 1) ≃ α => f 0 = a)).card = (n + 1).factorial := by
    rw [← Finset.card_eq_sum_card_fiberwise (fun _ _ => Finset.mem_univ _), Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_equiv (Fintype.equivOfCardEq (by simp [hα])), Fintype.card_fin]
  have hcnt : (Finset.univ.filter (fun f : Fin (n + 1) ≃ α => f 0 = a₀)).card = n.factorial := by
    rw [Finset.sum_congr rfl (fun a _ => heq a), Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, hα, smul_eq_mul, Nat.factorial_succ] at hsum
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (Nat.succ_pos n) hsum
  let s : Setoid (Fin (n + 1) ≃ α) :=
    { r := fun f g => ∃ k : Fin (n + 1), ∀ x, g x = f (x + k)
      iseqv :=
        { refl := fun f => ⟨0, fun x => by simp⟩
          symm := by
            rintro f g ⟨k, hk⟩
            exact ⟨-k, fun x => by rw [hk]; simp⟩
          trans := by
            rintro f g h ⟨k, hk⟩ ⟨l, hl⟩
            exact ⟨l + k, fun x => by rw [hl, hk, add_assoc]⟩ } }
  let φ : {f : Fin (n + 1) ≃ α // f 0 = a₀} → Quotient s := fun f => Quotient.mk s f.1
  have hφ : Function.Bijective φ := by
    constructor
    · rintro ⟨f, hf⟩ ⟨g, hg⟩ h
      obtain ⟨k, hk⟩ : s.r f g := Quotient.exact h
      have h0 := hk 0
      rw [hg, zero_add, ← hf] at h0
      have hk0 : k = 0 := (f.injective h0).symm
      apply Subtype.ext
      ext x
      simp only
      rw [hk x, hk0, add_zero]
    · intro q
      induction q using Quotient.inductionOn with
      | h f =>
        let k := f.symm a₀
        refine ⟨⟨(Equiv.addRight k).trans f, ?_⟩, ?_⟩
        · simp [k]
        · apply Quotient.sound
          refine ⟨-k, fun x => ?_⟩
          simp
  have hcard : Nat.card (Quotient s) = Nat.card {f : Fin (n + 1) ≃ α // f 0 = a₀} := (Nat.card_congr (Equiv.ofBijective φ hφ)).symm
  have : Nat.card (Quot (fun f g : Fin (n + 1) ≃ α => ∃ k : Fin (n + 1), ∀ x, g x = f (x + k))) = Nat.card (Quotient s) := rfl
  rw [this, hcard, Nat.card_eq_fintype_card, Fintype.card_subtype, hcnt]
target_source: ∀ (α : Type*) [Fintype α] [DecidableEq α] (n : ℕ), Fintype.card α = n + 1 → Nat.card (Quot (fun f g : Fin (n + 1) ≃ α => ∃ k : Fin (n + 1), ∀ x, g x = f (x + k))) = n.factorial
